cues.text: Your AI agent nailed the demo.
A run crashes halfway through, and all that work is gone.
A bug shows up once, and you can't reproduce it.
Every retry bills the same tokens again.
And waiting for a human sign-off means keeping a process alive for hours.
Chidori makes agents dependable, by default.
Every LLM call, tool call, and HTTP request goes through one runtime, and gets recorded.
You write plain async TypeScript. No graphs. No DSL.
Every await is a durable checkpoint.
So when a process dies mid-run, resume it in a new one.
Finished steps replay from the record. The model isn't called again, and the refund still goes out exactly once.
Need a person to approve? The run pauses to disk, with no process held open.
Answer minutes or days later, and it picks up where it stopped.
And every recorded run becomes a test.
Replay it in CI in milliseconds, with zero model calls, and catch drift before your customers do.
It's one Rust binary. Bring Anthropic, OpenAI, or any compatible model. Open source, under Apache 2.0.
Chidori. Ship agents you can trust.
Install it in one command, and start building today.
